snippet.title: Mr. Magpie's Harmless Card Game - Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616280/Mr_Magpies_Harmless_Card_Game/ 
Play the free demo: https://giantlight.itch.io/mr-magpies-harmless-card-game

Gameplay, Art, Audio, are all in development.
